messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — final draft of the release notes for the rollout later today is in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/rn-2026-03-21. Need ops + eng sign-off by 15:50 PT. Plan: pin internal blast at 16:50 PT, blast at 17:00 PT, public release later. TL;DR: runtime kernel selection fixes, default batching change, Dedicated autoscaler bugfix.

Sam: On it. Can you paste the 3-line internal blurb we should use?

Priya: Sure — "Today at 17:00 PT we will roll runtime v1.14.2 (kernels qk-0.9). Expect a gradual canary; customers on Dedicated may see short 1-3m throughput fluctuation. Watch latency + errors. Runbook + evac roster linked." Rollback criteria proposal: latency >2x baseline for 3m OR error rate >1% sustained for 10m -> rollback.

Alex: +1. I suggest we pin serving-runtime to v1.14.2 and quant-kernel to qk-0.9. Fallback target will be v1.14.1 if we rollback. Also: make the rollback window explicit in the RN.

Jin: Ops recs — canary path: us-west-2 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if all clear. Auto-rollback if metrics cross thresholds. I will arm quick reroute to standby pool.

DeployBot: Canary started for release/2026-03-21/rn -> group: us-west-2 @ 5%. Command used: `/deploy canary --tag release/2026-03-21 --group us-west-2 --pct 5`

Mia: I'll draft the internal announcement copy and pin it for ops read-ahead at 16:50. Evac roster: oncall primary @Sam, backend @Alex, infra @Jin, SRE backup @Lisa. I'm on comms.

Sam: Quick scrub: keep the internal copy 3 bullets + link to runbook. Add a single line: "No user-facing feature changes" so product teams don't over-alert customers.

Priya: Draft pasted in doc (short):
- What: runtime v1.14.2 + kernel qk-0.9 (performance/stability fixes)
- When: 17:00 PT (internal), canary -> us-west-2 5% -> 25% -> full
- Watch: latency & errors. Rollback if latency >2x baseline for 3m OR errors >1% for 10m.
Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/rn-2026-03-21-evac
Evac roster: https://docs.internal/redwood/evac-roster-2026-03-21

Alex: LGTM. :thumbsup:

Jin: I'll monitor the rollout dashboards and alert hooks. If DeployBot reports failure I'll post status here and trigger rollback.

DeployBot: Canary update: now at 25% in us-west-2. No anomalies detected in first 15m.

Mia: Planning to pin internal announcement at 16:50 PT for ops read-ahead, blast at 17:00. Any last-minute wording tweaks?

Sam: Add the "No user-facing feature changes" line and call out the rollback version explicitly.

Priya: Done. Thanks. If nothing flags by 17:25 PT, we promote to full at ~17:30 PT.

Mia: Posting the internal blast in 10m. :rocket:

Lisa: Standing by as SRE backup. Will jump on pager if needed.
